15005.name: Kalawao County
15005.note: Unverified lead, not yet independently checked. Kalaupapa has no medical facility; patients are flown to Oahu or Maui. Maui County's 911 helicopter with an AMR flight crew has served Kalaupapa (2019-2021 reports), but no current source names the carrier. The settlement was evacuated on September 11, 2026 after water and power failures.
